summary.en: Sun remains a specialty-generics business with a relatively small innovative clinical pipeline; innovative medicines accounted for 21.1% of Q2 FY27 sales. Selected assets include licensed oncology immunotherapies and an internally discovered GLP-1 program.
summary.zh: Sun 仍以特色仿制药业务为基础，创新临床管线相对精简；创新药占2027财年第二季度销售额的21.1%。重点在研项目包括引进的肿瘤免疫疗法及自主发现的GLP-1项目。

target.zh: 靶向纤维连接蛋白EDB结构域，递送IL-2与TNF

ind.en: Locally advanced melanoma (EMA filing; Sun rights in Europe, Australia and New Zealand); also BCC Phase 3 and cSCC Phase 2
ind.zh: 局部晚期黑色素瘤（EMA申报；Sun 权益限欧洲、澳大利亚及新西兰）；另包括III期基底细胞癌及II期皮肤鳞癌

target.en: Fibronectin extra-domain B-targeted TNF fusion protein
target.zh: 靶向纤维连接蛋白EDB结构域的TNF融合蛋白

ind.en: Soft tissue sarcoma (Phase 2 completed); also glioblastoma Phase 2
ind.zh: 软组织肉瘤（II期已完成）；另包括II期胶质母细胞瘤

next.en: Start Phase 3 in soft tissue sarcoma
next.zh: 启动软组织肉瘤III期研究

target.en: Liposomal intra-articular lubrication; no molecular target disclosed
target.zh: 脂质体关节腔内润滑；未披露分子靶点

ind.zh: 膝骨关节炎疼痛（II期已完成）

watch.en: GL0034 Phase 2 topline data are expected in the second half of calendar 2027.
watch.zh: GL0034 II期顶线数据预计于2027年下半年公布。

watch.en: Q2 FY27 US sales fell 8.2%; Sun attributes the decline largely to lenalidomide erosion.
watch.zh: 2027财年第二季度美国销售额下降8.2%，公司称主要受 lenalidomide 收入下滑影响。

watch.en: Organon integration planning is underway; indicative transaction closing is Q4 FY27.
watch.zh: Organon 整合筹备正在推进，交易预计于2027财年第四季度完成。

watch.en: Sun reported $3.3 billion consolidated net cash and issued INR78.16 billion of non-convertible debentures.
watch.zh: Sun 披露合并口径净现金33亿美元，并发行781.6亿印度卢比不可转换债券。

sources: Q2 FY27 financial release and pipeline, October 30, 2026
Nidlegy EMA validation and mechanism, July 4, 2024
gaps: Counts is null: Sun reports five novel clinical entities but no complete phase-count breakdown. The four unapproved assets explicitly named in the latest innovative-medicines table are included; no fifth unapproved asset was inferred.
Ilumya psoriatic arthritis is excluded because the October 2026 release confirms US approval. Lerodalcibep was not assigned an unverified regulatory stage in Sun territories.
No dates were disclosed for Nidlegy approval/launch, Fibromun Phase 3 initiation or MM-II partnering. Q4 FY27 for Organon is a fiscal quarter and is preserved as such in watch.
GL0034 precise modality was not explicitly established in the opened sources and is null. Nidlegy and Fibromun immunocytokine fusion proteins and MM-II liposomes are mapped to other.

Fibromun is Phase 2 per the latest Sun table, despite older releases describing pivotal/Phase III trials. Nidlegy is reg based on the latest EMA filing row and documented MAA validation; no approval date was verified.

Supporting sources older than 2026-06: Nidlegy mechanism/rights (July 2024), Fibromun mechanism/licensing (October 2024), MM-II mechanism/collaboration (April 2025), GL0034 internal discovery (June 2020), and utreglutide naming (November 2025). Stages and milestones use October 2026 materials.
